MARKET CHECK 🇫🇷 — SDM vs the new gen

SNEP week 47: BANTU MENTALITÉ by SDM & Ninho is new at No.1 singles, replacing Fille à Papa, and SDM's album IN INFINITUM lands at No.2 with 15 tracks in the singles Top 100. Under the storm, L2B's Dedans is the week's biggest rap climber, No.40 → No.13, and doubled its Spotify France streams. Fresh SNEP platinums and golds for HMZ & Werenoi, Maes, Yuston XIII and ISK.

🎧 Track: Dedans – L2B

Who's No.1 next week? Comment 1 for SDM & Ninho, 2 for Vacra & La Rvfleuze.

THE RADAR 🇵🇹 — Isak & Armando Teles

Porto's SMORRA crew just pulled off a full sweep: all five tracks of Salamanca, the new EP from Isak and Armando Teles (out 13 Nov on SMORRA Records, produced by Prod Vitor), entered Spotify Portugal's weekly chart in release week, led by Põe Na Conta at No.42. Their older songs climbed with them, and two Hard Club Porto nights on 3 and 4 December are reported sold out.

🎧 Track: Põe Na Conta – Isak & Armando Teles
